gramlot-js-server 0.2.4 follows the core 0.2.5, where a JavaScript page is one module that exports `Page` and `Logic`. It adds the gallery commands, the build of a folder of pages and a third package, `create-gramlot`.

## Changes

- `@gramlot/gramlot-js-server`
  - GET and HEAD serve the `.js` files below the pages folder, not only `*_aux.js`: the browser imports the page module for its `Logic` (core GC-090 §030).
  - **Mount prefix without a front server.** With `mountPath` every request path carries the prefix; the adapter removes it, answers 404 outside it and redirects the bare prefix to its slash. A front server forwards the path unchanged: with nginx, `proxy_pass http://127.0.0.1:8080;` without URI. A configuration of 0.2.3 that removes the prefix (`proxy_pass http://127.0.0.1:8080/;`) answers 404.
  - `/themes/<path>` serves the files of the core themes, with the media type of their extension. New option `assets` (URL path → `{file, type}`) for application files. Order: runtime, themes, assets, companions, pages.
  - `<path>/index.html` opens the page `<path>`, and `/index.html` the index, as on a static host.
  - Command `gramlot node gallery` and `gramlot bun gallery` (`--host`, `--port`, `--mount`, `--catalog`): the gallery of `@gramlot/gramlot-examples`, an optional peer dependency, with the family `node-01` or `bun-01`.
  - The core requirement is `@gramlot/gramlot` 0.2.5 or later.
- `@gramlot/gramlot-serverless`
  - The page logic is the `Logic` export of the page module, else `<name>_aux.js`; both are an error. Its bundle for the window takes `@gramlot/gramlot/page` from the core of the window.
  - `gramlot-serverless build` takes a page (one HTML file) or a folder of pages (one directory). In the single file, `Page.css` and `<name>.css` are written as `<style>`; `/themes/…` comes from the core package.
  - The directory export writes `<name>.css` to `assets/styles/<route>.css`, copies the `/themes/…` URLs of `Page.css` and replaces a previous export at the output.
  - Command `gramlot-serverless gallery <folder>`: the gallery with every family, opened from disk, with `serverless-01` and `serverless-02`.
  - `WorkerHost`: the option `aux` is now `logic`; new options `stylesheet` and `inlineCss`.
  - The build imports the page module, as `FileHost` does, to read `Page.css` and `Logic`; `main` runs only in the Worker.
- `create-gramlot` (new): `npm create gramlot page|site <folder>`, with `npm run build`, `npm start` and `npm run start:bun`, and a form that uses `gramlot.inout`.
- Documentation: a README for a first start, the tutorial GS-135 "No server", the guides updated.

```sh
npm create gramlot page my-form
npm install @gramlot/gramlot @gramlot/gramlot-js-server
npm install @gramlot/gramlot @gramlot/gramlot-serverless
```

## Verified

Node.js 23.11 and Bun 1.3.14, with the core 0.2.5 and `@gramlot/gramlot-examples` 0.2.4: the tests of the three packages; in Chromium 153 and WebKit 26.6 the page module as file and directory, the gallery on Node and Bun under `/js`, the gallery from disk, the templates from disk and from `npm start`.
